thesis: The speakers discuss their twenty-year history of meeting regularly to talk about investing and life, noting that this is their first gathering since the pandemic. They debate the investment case for crypto, with one speaker likening it to gold as a commodity valued by future price rather than intrinsic utility, while another suggests it has practical uses in areas like healthcare and transaction systems.
